```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE,
                      fig.align = "center", dpi = 300)
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = here::here())

if (!require("pacman")) install.packages("pacman")
pacman::p_load(here, dplyr, knitr, kableExtra, scales, dampack,
               flexsurv, survival)

suppressMessages(suppressWarnings({
  source(here("scripts/R/analysis/02_setup_and_global_variables.R"))
  source(here("scripts/R/analysis/03_biomarker_strategies.R"))
}))

invisible(capture.output(
  source(here("scripts/R/analysis/08b_enriched_population_analysis.R"))
))
```

```{r display-table}
detail_cols <- c("Biomarker", "Enr_Cost", "Enr_Effect",
                 "Enr_Ctrl_Cost", "Enr_Ctrl_Effect", "Enr_ICER")

kable(
  enriched_display[, detail_cols],
  caption = "Table 6: Biomarker-enriched population results",
  format = "html",
  col.names = c("Biomarker", "Experimental Cost", "Experimental QALYs",
                "Control Cost", "Control QALYs", "ICER"),
  align = c("l", rep("r", 5))
) %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"),
                full_width = FALSE, font_size = 11) %>%
  footnote(
    general = c(
      "Enriched analysis restricts both arms to biomarker-positive patients.",
      "Experimental arm: FLOX + nivolumab. Control arm: FLOX only.",
      "Costs and QALYs discounted at 4% per year."
    ),
    general_title = "Notes: "
  )
```

```{r save-table, include=FALSE}
tables_dir <- here("tables")
if (!dir.exists(tables_dir)) dir.create(tables_dir, recursive = TRUE)
write.csv(enriched_comparison, file = here("tables", "table_6.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
```

Table 6 has been saved to `tables/table_6.csv`.
